rationale: The agent showed clear confusion about tool usage, particularly repeatedly calling `run_python_file` with shell commands and inline Python code (e.g., iterations 3-7, 10-11, 13-14, 16, 19) when the tool expects a path to a Python file. It also made redundant `get_files_info` calls (iterations 1-2 with identical results) and repeatedly attempted to write to `/tmp/` despite consistent 'outside permitted working directory' errors (iterations 8, 12, 15, 20).
